item.description:
First distributed release.

Added

  • Container control plane: typed SpireDeployment manifests rendered into reviewable Apple container commands, with a deny-by-default capability broker between the GUI/CLI and mutation.
  • MLX inference host (spire-mlx): chat, embedding, and rerank roles served concurrently over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with per-role health.
  • MCP server (spire-mcp) so AI agents can drive deployments under operator-granted capabilities.
  • SwiftUI app with onboarding, settings, menu-bar presence, and Sparkle auto-update; spire CLI sharing the same model.
  • Fleet daemon lifecycle: spire-mlx install-daemon installs a system LaunchDaemon on headless hosts and fails loudly unless launchd reports the service running.
  • Signing chain: Developer ID, hardened runtime, notarization, stapling — verified with a quarantined copy on a second Mac.

[Unreleased]: https://github.com/Truth-Forge/spire-releases/releases [1.0.0]: https://github.com/Truth-Forge/spire-releases/releases/tag/v1.0.0-70
